name: Hacker News official Firebase API
selection: The newest 1,000,000 item IDs (stories, comments, jobs, polls, pollopts) by consecutive ID ending at maxitem; every id fetched, none missing/null/errored
completeness_limitations: Snapshot: score, descendants and dead/deleted flags are as of fetch time; very recent items may later change. Items are by ID, so 'posts' includes comments (about 84% comments). Credential-shaped strings (4 found: API keys etc.) were replaced with [REDACTED-SECRET] in text fields before publishing (scripts/redact_secrets.py); all else is verbatim.
